8248.title: Provider browse state is absent from the model picker
8248.rootCauseOneLine: The picker uses its active provider only for underline styling, omitting a visible catalog name and programmatic pressed state.
8248.proposedFix: Render the existing active provider label and expose aria-pressed on the native provider buttons, preserving their selection path and adding a keyboard focus ring.
8248.caveats: Reproduced directly in two clean trusted-base checkouts by the same agent. Browser evidence uses the real picker with repository catalog fixtures, not a live provider account. Chromium touch emulation is not iOS Safari verification. Test source and output are inline.
